# Affan's Mojito

> A small mojito brand. Every drink is built one glass at a time — ice, mint
> pressed against the glass, fruit dropped in, soda poured last — in four
> flavors: lime, strawberry, apple and mango. Nothing comes from a syrup pump.
> Orders are taken on the phone.

This is a one-page site. The sections below are anchors on
[the home page](/), not separate documents.

## Brand facts

- Name: Affan's Mojito
- Tagline: Mojitos, muddled to order.
- Phone: 9322437454
- Email: affanjavedshah@gmail.com
- One drink: 300 ml — one glass
- Alcoholic: yes, made with white rum
- Shelf life: made to order, so drink it fresh
- Price: not published — quoted on the phone

## Flavors

- [Lime](/#flavor-lime) — Sharp enough to wake you up. Ingredients: lime, mint,
  cane sugar, white rum, soda. 92 kcal.
- [Strawberry](/#flavor-strawberry) — Summer, muddled. Ingredients: strawberry,
  basil, cane sugar, white rum, soda. 98 kcal.
- [Apple](/#flavor-apple) — Crisp enough to hear. Ingredients: green apple, mint,
  lime, white rum, soda. 88 kcal.
- [Mango](/#flavor-mango) — Thick sun, poured slow. Ingredients: mango, chilli,
  lime, white rum, soda. 104 kcal.

## Pages

- [Home](/) — the whole site: the flavors, the facts, the FAQ and how to order.
- [About the brand](/#about-brand) — what Affan's Mojito is, and the facts list
  for every flavor.

## Ordering

Orders are taken on the phone, on 9322437454. Prices are quoted when you call;
none are published on the site.
